countedBy: Two independent blind counts disagreed (7 vs 9 rows); integrator recount 2026-10-10 from the photo: gable window 2 glazed tiers, 5 window storeys, double-height ground floor 2 tiers (transom) = 9 rows of 5. Five identical gabled bays, each mirror-symmetric; no setbacks on the street front. openings adds glassRail because the bay-5 balustrades are glass.

facades.name: street front (NW)
facades.note: Photo: bay 0 has a louvre strip down its left side and an enclosed glass box; bay 4 has glass balustrades. So only bays 1-3 are identical and per-bay symmetry is not asserted for every bay (the field is all-or-nothing).
